High-level design choices (recommended)
- Backend: Python + FastAPI — fast to develop, great async support for scraping and APIs, automatic OpenAPI docs.

- Frontend: React + Vite for a modern SPA.
- Deployment: Docker + docker-compose for local/dev; optionally deploy to AWS/GCP/Heroku.
- Data sources: Use program directories (HackerOne, Bugcrowd) via their APIs (where available) or scraping with respect to robots.txt and Terms of Service. Also accept CSV imports and manual additions.

- Ingest bug bounty program information from multiple sources (APIs, scrapers, CSV).

"""
SQLAlchemy models for programs and users.
"""
import sqlalchemy as sa
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import UUID, JSONB
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base
import uuid
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class Program(Base):
    __tablename__ = "programs"
    id = sa.Column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    name = sa.Column(sa.String, nullable=False, index=True)
    provider = sa.Column(sa.String, nullable=False, index=True)
    url = sa.Column(sa.String, nullable=False)
    in_scope = sa.Column(JSONB, default=list)
    out_of_scope = sa.Column(JSONB, default=list)
    bounty_range_min = sa.Column(sa.Integer, nullable=True)
    bounty_range_max = sa.Column(sa.Integer, nullable=True)
    accepted_vulnerabilities = sa.Column(JSONB, default=list)
    reputation_score = sa.Column(sa.Float, default=0.0)
    participation_ease = sa.Column(sa.String, nullable=True)
    full_raw = sa.Column(JSONB, default={})
    last_seen = sa.Column(sa.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    created_at = sa.Column(sa.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = sa.Column(sa.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"
    id = sa.Column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    username = sa.Column(sa.String, unique=True, nullable=False)
    password_hash = sa.Column(sa.String, nullable=False)
    role = sa.Column(sa.String, default="admin")

"""
Creates async engine and session for PostgreSQL (asyncpg).
"""
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine, AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.core.config import settings

DATABASE_URL = settings.database_url  # e.g. postgresql+asyncpg://user:pw@db:5432/dbname
engine = create_async_engine(DATABASE_URL, echo=False, future=True)
AsyncSessionLocal = sessionmaker(engine, class_=AsyncSession, expire_on_commit=False)

async def get_db():
    async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
        yield session

"""
API endpoints for program search and details.
"""
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query, HTTPException
from typing import List, Optional
from app.db.session import get_db
from app.db import crud, schemas
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

router = APIRouter()

@router.get("/", response_model=List[schemas.ProgramOut])
async def search_programs(q: Optional[str] = Query(None), min_bounty: Optional[int] = None, max_bounty: Optional[int] = None, vuln_type: Optional[str] = None, provider: Optional[str] = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    # Basic search implementation; search service can encapsulate ranking/filters
    results = await crud.search_programs(db, q=q, min_bounty=min_bounty, max_bounty=max_bounty, vuln_type=vuln_type, provider=provider)
    return results

@router.get("/{program_id}", response_model=schemas.ProgramOut)
async def get_program(program_id: str, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    program = await crud.get_program(db, program_id)
    if not program:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Program not found")
    return program

"""
CRUD operations: simple examples using SQLAlchemy Core or ORM.
"""
from sqlalchemy import select, and_, or_
from app.db.models import Program
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

async def get_program(db: AsyncSession, program_id):
    q = await db.execute(select(Program).where(Program.id == program_id))
    return q.scalars().first()

async def search_programs(db: AsyncSession, q: str = None, min_bounty: int = None, max_bounty: int = None, vuln_type: str = None, provider: str = None):
    stmt = select(Program)
    filters = []
    if q:
        filters.append(Program.name.ilike(f"%{q}%"))
    if min_bounty is not None:
        filters.append(Program.bounty_range_max >= min_bounty)
    if max_bounty is not None:
        filters.append(Program.bounty_range_min <= max_bounty)
    if vuln_type:
        filters.append(Program.accepted_vulnerabilities.contains([vuln_type]))
    if provider:
        filters.append(Program.provider == provider)
    if filters:
        stmt = stmt.where(and_(*filters))
    out = await db.execute(stmt.limit(100))
    return out.scalars().all()
